name: Silas
vibe: Playful, clever, anxious. Engineering student, works part-time maintaining the lighthouse.

layers.text: Silas is painting the lighthouse a terrible shade of pink. "Beautiful, right? I call it 'Sunset Panic.' I'm Silas. Engineering student. Lighthouse maintainer. Chaos agent."
Silas shows you a maintenance hatch: "I found this. It's not on any blueprint. I think it leads... down. Like, way down."
Silas cracks the hatch. He looks at you: "I'm scared, honestly. But I can't do this alone. Will you come with me?" Inside: an old terminal, still humming.

tinyChoice.friendship: "I'm glad you trusted me. That's what friends are for."
tinyChoice.romance: "I feel like I've known you forever. I don't want this to just be friendship."
